limits: Warm million-row constructed float columns on one host. Direct-native eligibility is separately qualified; the public operators are timed. Retained/legacy/noncanonical/temporal cases have correctness coverage but no throughput claim. Missing-bearing bare R uses a different contract.
validation: Full R suite and focused tests use the same clean candidate-v1 library as timing. Rust bridge tests use candidate-prototype, whose complete src/ inventory matches candidate-v1. Required conformance rebuilds the same package sources into a source archive and runs R CMD check. The exact timed controller and source changes are retained by commits and hash inventories.
